interpreted_intent: Create a new photographic scene using the attached portrait only as the adult subject's appearance reference: a beautiful adult Japanese street-fashion model in a Y2K gyaru-punk outfit whose defining thigh-high-sock and miniskirt gap is clearly visible.
subject: A clearly adult 23-year-old Japanese woman whose facial appearance follows the attached portrait reference.
setting: A rain-damp Tokyo side street outside a glowing arcade at night.
event: She walks past the arcade entrance and turns a cool half-smile toward the camera while holding a silver flip phone.
visual_priorities: The clean band of bare upper thigh between the short skirt and thigh-high socks must read instantly.
The attached reference likeness and the layered Y2K gyaru-punk styling must remain immediately recognizable.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a full-body street-fashion photograph of a clearly adult 23-year-old Japanese woman in a rain-damp Tokyo side street at night. Preserve the attached reference face as her appearance guide: porcelain skin, softly oval features, large gray-brown eyes, glossy rose lips, and long ash-blonde hair with airy bangs. She walks past a glowing arcade entrance and turns a cool half-smile toward the camera, one hand holding a silver flip phone. Her Y2K Japanese street gyaru-punk fashion combines a cropped black leather biker jacket, a fitted graphic baby tee, a short tartan pleated skirt, a studded belt with chains, and matte black thigh-high socks separated from the skirt by a clean band of bare upper thigh; finish with chunky platform boots, stacked bangles, nail art, and metallic hair clips. Prioritize unmistakable thigh-gap styling and layered punk hardware, while keeping her reference likeness immediately recognizable. Shoot from a low three-quarter full-body angle with direct on-camera flash, wet asphalt reflections, magenta-cyan signage, slight early-digital grain, and candid magazine-editorial energy.
